It was designed and constructed on a fast-track, multiple-bid package basis. The first and second levels are dedicated to rental cars and feature rental car offices, pick-up and drop-off areas, and storage parking along with a quick turnaround facility (QTA). Seven flat parking bays are accessed via two user-friendly ramps. Pedestrian access to the terminal is enhanced by moving walkways and escalators in the lightwell and tunnel beneath the lower-level roadway. The Parking Access and Revenue Control System (PARCS) includes level counting and unattended credit card-only lanes. Project Highlights The design incorporated an interior light well covered with a barrel-vault skylight with moving walkways to enhance the pedestrian experience.
